caveat: Proxy scales recorded pose-feedback qdot and does not re-solve the QP; it is diagnostic support, not an acceptance result.
model: semi-implicit M^-1[Kp(qref-q)+Kd(dqref-dq)] with recorded R11 qdot/M/Kp/Kd and retained tau=0.10 velocity capture
selection_rule: Freeze the single global scale 0.75 before R12 Isaac runs; no post-run tuning.
